root.label: PSNI Drumcree operation discussed by chief constable

events.label: PSNI Drumcree operation discussed by chief constable

slots.name: policing operation cost
slots.sentence: Police Service of Northern Ireland (PSNI) Chief Constable Jon Boutcher discussed the dispute at a public meeting of the Policing Board in Belfast on Thursday where he said the policing operation over the dispute has cost about £3m so far.

slots.name: violence status
slots.sentence: He described the situation as "challenging" - but said that despite "very significant tensions" there had been no violence.
